  • Wireless charging possible ¹

  • Adds shock resistance to your phone
  • CNC machined from aircraft grade aluminum
  • Portrait / Landscape Orientation
  • 360° rotation
  • Stainless steel hardware

source_description_html:
With the SP Connect Moto Stem Bundle, you can attach your smartphone to your supersport motorcycle easily. Fasten the Moto Bundle  to the handlebars of your motorcycle and you are ready to mount the SP Connect Phone Connect by placing it on the mount and turning it 90° clockwise. To further protect your smartphone the mount also has a unique vibration dampening system that cuts G-forces by up to 40% (depending on bike & phone model). Your mobile phone is securely positioned right in the center of your vision, allowing you to navigate, access your playlists, read messages. Use the WEATHER COVER to protect your phone from rain and dirt as well as to provide additional shock resistance if necessary. Features:
  • Professional set
  • Smartphone shell
  • Weather Cover
  • Moto Mount Pro bracket
  • Compatible with all SP Connect products
  • Secure locking through 90 ° rotation
  • Slim, protective, functional
  • Use of all ports and buttons
  • 3-layer case construction for ultimate safeguarding
  • Wireless charging possible ¹
  • Protects against rain, sweat, dust or mud
  • Adds shock resistance to your phone
  • CNC machined from aircraft grade aluminum
  • Portrait / Landscape Orientation
  • 360° rotation
  • Stainless steel hardware
Specifications: Compatibility:
  • iPhone 12/12 Pro
  • Fits standard and oversize handlebars ( Ø 2,22 / 2,54 / 2,86 / 3,17 cm or 0,875 / 1,0 / 1,125 / 1,25 inches)
Manufacturer's Note: Attention: If you are using a smartphone with a mechanical image stabilizer, we recommend the use of our additional vibration reducing module Anti Vibration Module to best prevent possible damage to your phone's camera caused by vibrations from motorcycle engines. In case you still experience problems, please do not use the product in combination with this smartphone and contact the manufacturer of your smartphone if you are unsure.

Note: Strong screen protectors or gloves may limit the usability of your touch screen in combination with the Weather Cover. The Weather Cover restricts the homebutton functionality of iPhone SE (2020), 8, 8 Plus, 7 & 7 Plus. This can be bypassed by activating the software homebutton (Assistive Touch) feature.

¹ Wirelessly charging the iPhone 12 series in combination with the SP Connect Phone Case is possible with a wide variety of inductive chargers. Best results are obtained if the components of both the USB cable and power adapter comply with the QC 3.0 standard (Quick Charge 3.0) or higher. Inductive charging with the Apple MagSafe charger is not possible.

Contents:
  • 1 x SP Connect phone case
  • 1 x SP Connect weather cover
  • 1 x SP Connect Moto Stem Pro mount
  • 1 x SP Connect StandTool mount
  • 3 x Plastic spacing inserts
